::: {#rem-binary-entropy}
#### Binary entropy is the entropy of a coin

$h(\epsilon)$ is the [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy),
in bits, of a random variable that takes one of two values,
one of them with probability $\epsilon$.
It is $0$ when the outcome is certain and largest, $1$ bit, at $\epsilon = 1/2$.

:::
